audit_comment: APPENDIX 3: THE CLERICAL QUICK-REFERENCE CHARTS, BATCH FOUR - the D&DG walk round twenty-four, print pp. 139-140: the fourth batch of deity rows - Greek (18), Indian (13) - riding the roster data file, the Greek block below the R871 Finnish tail on pdf 139, the Indian block spanning the pdf 139 tail / 140 head; the App 3 gap box stays open until the last chart batch lands. The print voice is the ROTATED tesseract pass, collated against the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows. The headline divergence: the print reads two X marks for Aphrodite (M and F) where the L&L voice reads female-only - pinned by print, eyeball flag.

banner.title: Appendix 3: the clerical quick-reference chart, batch four - the D&DG walk round twenty-four, print pp. 139-140: the 31 rows of the Greek and Indian pantheons across the 13 printed columns.
banner.provenance: primary ink: the ROTATED extract/ddg tesseract pass (pNNN_rot_full.txt + pNNN_rot_tsv.tsv, pdf pages 139-140; the second printing) - the Greek block sits below the R871 Finnish tail on pdf 139, the Indian block spans the pdf 139 tail and the pdf 140 head; the collation voice: the 1eonline L&L per-deity chart rows (the zeus and aphrodite slugs plain). The adjudications: the Aphrodite X pair (print over the L&L female-only read, eyeball flag, the Druaga precedent), the Zeus white / red sunrise column split (both voices agree - an eyeball oddity), the Poseidon seqa garble restored to sea; earthquakes from L&L, the Apollo laure! garble restored to laurel wreath, the Indra rainbow pinned plain (the L&L <> glyph an artifact), the Yama no-article form pinned (the L&L a noted) with the stray colon glyph noted, the Ushas at-dawn fold restored (the Arawn class), and the Rudra red, black comma pinned. The batch order runs Greek, Indian.
